turns.q: If they want to exchange it, how would that work?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: If your gift recipient wants to exchange the item, they can do so easily! Here’s how it works: - They can visit the Faherty [Returns Center](https://fahertybrand.loopreturns.com/#/) and select “Received a gift? Start here.” - They’ll need the order number (found on the packing slip) or your name/email. - They can choose to exchange the item or return it for store credit. - Exchanges can be done by dropping off the item at a Return Bar location (for the fastest processing) or by mailing it… Navigate to the message to read the full response.DisclosureBy using this chat, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in our privacy policy.Agent saidHi! I’m Sunny, Faherty’s AI shopping assistant. I can help you find pieces, compare fits, or answer questions about an order. What can I help with?You saidHi! I'm looking for a gift for someone and I'm not sure what to pick, can you help?

turns.q: Any discount if I add a second smaller item?
turns.replyText:
Customer CareAgent said: Faherty sometimes offers bundle discounts on select items, like Sunwashed Tees or Movement Shirts, but there isn’t a general discount for adding a second smaller item to your cart. Discounts and promotions are only available for specific products or bundles, and you can find current offers on the website. If you have a specific discount code, I can help check if it applies. Would you like to see some smaller items that might pair well with your beanie?DisclosureBy using this chat, you are accepting and consenting to the practices described in our privacy policy.Agent saidHi!
